Senses.Explanation: Do not raise a child too big, lest when grown he become a thief in the house: the cultivated heir may turn the resources of his own household against it. Ciming Chuyuan appends the warning to his verse on Zhaozhou's cypress-tree answer, where roaming Chan visitors make a household succession image pointed. Mingzhao Qian and Kaishan Qian each invoke the same line while commenting on Xuansha's three blank sheets and Xuefeng's claim of sharing one wind across a thousand miles.
